summary: Keep DNS audit, drift detection, filtered-search counters, truncation state, BIND TXT output, and ACME reporting aligned with the records actually evaluated.
reason: Cross-zone commands must not miss renamed or retyped records, report a broader scan boundary than requested, accept a DMARC policy at the wrong owner name, hide limited results, emit raw control bytes into a zone file, or report planned ACME zones as successful.
validated_outcome: Focused regression tests cover DMARC owner/value validation, filtered scan metrics, drift across name/type/value/TTL changes, explicit truncation state, and BIND-safe control-character escaping.
